regions.full_page: Suecide Positively Averted. James John Kulick 37 of 4933 Vinwood, makes all prepares for death by suicide - final will in all details, even to choice of coffin, ready to go on boat to Cleveland. His two sisters receiving leaflets and word of explanation at Father's funeral, about S.M. Assoc. Enrolles their desperate brother that day - October 16. Today sister Grace returns in tears of joy that every vistage of danger disapeared that night - her brother now in hope and praying. To go to work Nov. 24. To-day enrolls her other Br. Ed as against tuberculosis - April 18 Same Br. Edw'd re- ported in perfect health; Deo Gr!
